INSERT INTO "channel_trust" ("channel_kind", "level", "permissions")
SELECT 'sms', 'low', '[]'
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "channel_trust" WHERE "channel_kind" = 'sms')
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO "channel_trust" ("channel_kind", "level", "permissions")
SELECT 'email', 'standard', NULL
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "channel_trust" WHERE "channel_kind" = 'email')
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO "notice_preference" ("principal", "event_kind", "urgency", "channels")
SELECT NULL, '*', '*', '["sms","email"]'
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "notice_preference" WHERE "principal" IS NULL AND "event_kind" = '*' AND "urgency" = '*')
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

CREATE TRIGGER "trg_account_references_clear" AFTER DELETE ON "account" FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
  -- The references to the row of Account deleted (D154, D182), cleared,
  -- and the row that held each told on its cleared queue.
  INSERT INTO "reference_cleared_queue" ("holder_table", "holder_key", "target_table", "target_key", "role")
    SELECT 'Ticket', CAST("ticket_id" AS TEXT), "target_table", "target_key", "role" FROM "ticket_references" WHERE "target_table" = 'Account' AND "target_key" = CAST(OLD."id" AS TEXT);
  DELETE FROM "ticket_references" WHERE "target_table" = 'Account' AND "target_key" = CAST(OLD."id" AS TEXT);
END
triggers.name: trg_account_references_clear

trg_ticket_audience_insert

triggers.backfillNote: Backfilling trg_ticket_audience_update resolves the audience of every row of ticket.
triggers.definition:
CREATE TRIGGER "trg_ticket_audience_update" AFTER UPDATE ON "ticket" FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NEW."audience" IS NULL OR NEW."audience" NOT IN ('everyone', 'private', 'named')
  OR NEW."agent_access" IS NULL OR NEW."agent_access" NOT IN ('followRole', 'readOnly', 'none')
  OR NEW."effective_audience" IS NOT CASE NEW."audience" WHEN 'everyone' THEN NULL WHEN 'private' THEN CASE WHEN NEW."owner" IS NULL THEN '[]' ELSE json_array(NEW."owner") END WHEN 'named' THEN (SELECT json_group_array(audience_member.value) FROM (SELECT NEW."owner" AS value WHERE NEW."owner" IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT value FROM json_each(COALESCE(NEW."audience_named", '[]')) WHERE value IS NOT NULL) AS audience_member) ELSE CASE WHEN NEW."owner" IS NULL THEN '[]' ELSE json_array(NEW."owner") END END
  OR NEW."effective_agents" IS NOT NEW."agent_access"
BEGIN
  -- The @audience of Ticket (D156, D182): the row's audience resolved into
  -- effective_audience and effective_agents, whatever writes the row.
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'ticket.audience is none of everyone, private, named') WHERE NEW."audience" IS NULL OR NEW."audience" NOT IN ('everyone', 'private', 'named');
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'ticket.agent_access is none of followRole, readOnly, none') WHERE NEW."agent_access" IS NULL OR NEW."agent_access" NOT IN ('followRole', 'readOnly', 'none');
  UPDATE "ticket" SET "effective_audience" = CASE "ticket"."audience" WHEN 'everyone' THEN NULL WHEN 'private' THEN CASE WHEN "ticket"."owner" IS NULL THEN '[]' ELSE json_array("ticket"."owner") END WHEN 'named' THEN (SELECT json_group_array(audience_member.value) FROM (SELECT "ticket"."owner" AS value WHERE "ticket"."owner" IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT value FROM json_each(COALESCE("ticket"."audience_named", '[]')) WHERE value IS NOT NULL) AS audience_member) ELSE CASE WHEN "ticket"."owner" IS NULL THEN '[]' ELSE json_array("ticket"."owner") END END,
    "effective_agents" = "ticket"."agent_access"
    WHERE "ticket"."id" = NEW."id";
END
triggers.name: trg_ticket_audience_update
